description: Per-pixel SPAD timing offset calibration map. Each value is the offset (ps) of that pixel's IRF peak relative to the sensor-wide median, measured from a 120 s DASPI IRF acquisition (63x objective, low100p laser, nd0.5 filter). Shape is (H, W) after the standard 90-deg CCW rotation applied by flim_core.io.load_flim_data — apply to cube in that same orientation. NaN pixels had insufficient photons (<30 counts) and are skipped.
